On **April 5, 2024**, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted **accelerated approval** to fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (Enhertu®) for adult patients with **unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumors** who have received prior systemic treatment and have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.

This was a landmark decision — it made trastuzumab deruxtecan the **first antibody-drug conjugate (ADC)** and the **first HER2-directed therapy** to receive a tumor-agnostic FDA approval. The approval was based on objective response rate and duration of response data from three clinical trials: **DESTINY-PanTumor02**, **DESTINY-Lung01**, and **DESTINY-CRC02**, which together evaluated 192 adult patients across numerous solid tumor types.
